project_type: Python FastAPI Document Management System with RAG/LLM Wiki pipeline
build_system: uv (package manager), pyproject.toml for project config. Use 'uv add <package>' to add dependencies.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient for FastAPI endpoint tests, unittest.mock for mocking external services
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv sync' to install dependencies. 2. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' to run all tests (82 existing + new). 3. Run 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' for linting.
setup_instructions: 1. Python 3.11 via pyenv already active. 2. 'uv sync' installs all deps. 3. Tests use in-memory SQLite and tmp_path fixtures.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. uv available. No Docker daemon. External services (OpenAI, tesseract, scanners) must be mocked in tests.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: async SQLAlchemy models in app/models/, Pydantic schemas in app/schemas/, route handlers in app/api/, services in app/services/, core utilities in app/core/. Type hints throughout. Ruff-clean code.
key_patterns: FastAPI dependency injection, SQLAlchemy async with get_db dependency, background tasks for pipeline, unittest.mock.patch for external services, Pydantic BaseModel for request/response schemas, DeclarativeBase in app/models/group.py shared across all models
directory_structure: app/ - main application package. app/api/ - route handlers (groups, documents, search, wiki). app/models/ - SQLAlchemy models (Base defined in group.py). app/schemas/ - Pydantic schemas. app/services/ - business logic (converter, preprocessing, pipeline, wiki, vectordb, storage, chunker). app/core/ - config, database, llm. tests/ - pytest tests with conftest.py fixtures. wiki/ - LLM wiki output. storage/ - uploaded files.
